conclusion.without_parity: Integer equality at n>=3 forces a=0 or b=0 or c=0, not a=0 or b=0.
conclusion.odd: For Odd n, equality iff (a=0 and b=c) or (b=0 and a=c) or (c=0 and b=-a). Fixed output fiber is {(0,c),(c,0)} union {p | c=0 and p.2=-p.1}.
conclusion.even: For Even n, equality iff (a=0 and (b=c or b=-c)) or (b=0 and (a=c or a=-c)). Fixed output fiber is {(0,c),(0,-c),(c,0),(-c,0)}, a set whose entries coincide at c=0.
